summary: Bulgari revived its gold and steel pairing for its signature collections, while Cartier launched a LOVE unlimited collection in gold and diamonds on the Seine.

De Beers introduced the 'Vibrations' collection inspired by water and agreed to take full ownership of the Gahcho Kué diamond mine, also gaining a stake in a Canadian mine through Mountain Province's restructuring.
Pandora expanded its manufacturing capacity by 50% with a new facility in Vietnam, and Tiffany & Co. launched the Eternity collection combining Italian glass art, diamonds, and fine jewellery.
